wrong.why: Verse 27 closes this block as the sons of Jeroham, a name the text keeps distinct from Jeremoth of verse 14, the person the row points to.
Verse 26 names Shehariah among the sons of Jeroham (closed in verse 27), and Shashak's sons end at verse 25, so the chapter does not say he descends from Shashak.

missing.why: Verse 27 lists Jaresiah among the sons of Jeroham, and no row gives him that father.
Verse 27 lists Eliah among the sons of Jeroham, and only brother rows are recorded for him.
Verse 27 lists Zichri among the sons of Jeroham, and only brother rows are recorded for him.
Verse 26 names Athaliah in the block that verse 27 closes as the sons of Jeroham, and no row records him at all.
Verse 26 names Shehariah in the block that verse 27 closes as the sons of Jeroham, and his only row gives a different father.

note: Every owner row checked is consistent with the text, so none is listed as wrong; sachia, mirmah and jeuz son-of hodesh go beyond verse 10, which does not name their mother. The site's brackets equate Shimhi of verse 21 with Shema of verse 13, and Jeroham with Jeremoth, which the text does not say; gera-5 and gera-6 duplicate gera for verses 3 and 5, left unjudged.
